start_here: Say to your AI: "Open my booking page application." It runs tool:read-a-booking-page and takes the person through the email, the questions and the time.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one booking page row and its form from the pursuit database you name and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-a-booking-page and the input.
3. Read the answer: the page title, time zone, session length and questions. Show it with the screen the tool names.
